facts.text: I asked to title case the text: "An observational pilot study to collect safety and efficacy data on wound care using whole blood clot technology on hard-to-heal wounds".
I asked to title case the text: "Chronic venus ulcer pain reduction and full recovery by an autologous blood clot: A case study".
I asked for the steps needed to write a product profile description.
I asked to explain the first, second, and body of the description.
I asked for the IDEAL description writing technique.
I told the assistant to use the manual above that I told you about.
I told the assistant to use the "Product description writing manual" above.
I provided a manual for writing the first sentence of a product description.
I stated that the first sentence always contains the product name, what the product is, and what it is used for.
I stated that the description should always start with the name of the product profile using the full name exactly as it is.
I stated that the product should be described in a couple of words (adjective, adjective noun) when not obvious from the name.
I stated that what the product is used for should be derived from the approved indications/intended use and/or manufacturer literature.
I stated that when restating indications/intended use, the description should be concise while not excluding critical information.
I stated that the description should not just restate the exact wording of the indications/intended use from the filing or other source.
I stated that the description should state the components, materials, ingredients, etc. that make up the product.
I stated that a layperson should be able to visualize the product in their head with the product image.
I stated that the description should explain what other product(s) the product is used in conjunction with and how.

I provided an example sentence for "The Anchor Tissue Retrieval System" describing capturing and removing tissue and organs during laparoscopic surgeries including appendectomy, hysterectomy, cholecystectomy, and oophorectomy.

I provided filing text for "The Anchor Tissue Retrieval System" describing a sterile disposable pouch used with a dedicated introducer for capture and removal of an organ or tissue from the body cavity during laparoscopic surgery.

I provided an example sentence for "The Target 360 Detachable Coil" describing embolization coil use in neurovascular and peripheral vessels to occlude or obstruct blood flow including intracranial aneurysms.

I provided filing text for "Target Coils" describing intended endovascular obstruction or occlusion of blood flow in neurovascular and peripheral vessels including intracranial aneurysms, arteriovenous malformations, arteriovenous fistulae, and arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral vasculature.

events.text: Requested title casing for an observational pilot study title about whole blood clot technology for hard-to-heal wounds.
Requested title casing for a case study title about chronic venus ulcer pain reduction and full recovery by an autologous blood clot.
Asked for steps to write a product profile description, including first, second, and body sections, and the IDEAL description writing technique.
Provided a manual for writing the first sentence of a product description, including rules and examples for Anchor Tissue Retrieval System and Target 360 Detachable Coil.
